sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam. All photos and videos to be attached to the end-of-shift report.
Geared up and heading out on patrols.
Check-in at Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, no issues to report.
Patrolling Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Commercial Bay full sweep complete; also welfare check at Britomart McDonald's, no issues to report.
Responding to a call from Queen Street McDonald's due to an individual troubling customers.
Arrived on site and spoke to the individual, asking him to move along; it took a while because the individual was heavily intoxicated and could not walk properly.
The individual has left the premises, no further issues. Heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
On standby at HQ charging the Ops Phone.
Morning shift deployed; patrolling Queen Street.
Welfare check at Starbucks, Lotus Foreign Exchange, Nike, Cotton On, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Mecca, Chemist Warehouse, Kathmandu, Macpac, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Faradays, no issues to report; Shortland Street also all clear.
Welfare check at Britomart McDonald's, no issues to report.
Patrolling Commercial Bay, commencing a full sweep; will also be on standby showing security presence.
Commercial Bay all clear, no issues at this time.
Welfare check at Woolworths and Aotea Gifts, no issues to report. Patrolling Customs Street.
Welfare check at Adidas and Movenpick Hotel, all clear, no issues to report.
Response call from the Metropolis Hotel asking us to come and stand by due to a triggered fire alarm.
Arrived on site and touched base with Fernando, who asked us to stand by in case of any outburst from the public.
The fire alarms have stopped, no further issues to report.
Welfare check at Vagabond and Circle K, no issues.
Check-in at Chancery Square / Freyberg Square, all clear, no issues to report.
Just as we were about to leave, fire trucks arrived at the Metropolis — three trucks by the looks of it. (Photo on file.) Standing by for further security presence.
Welfare check at Woolworths Victoria Street and Chemist Warehouse, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.

Call from Platypus — a tall, light-skinned male in a red "You Know" sweater stole three basketball hats from their store; direction of travel unknown. Will patrol down Queen Street to look for the person of interest.
Swept down Queen Street looking for the person of interest matching the Platypus description; no sign of him. Standing by for security presence.
At the office using the restroom.

Heard a vagrant at the corner of Ippondo say something inconceivable; when we approached he said he was coughing. Asked him to keep the volume down. (Footage on file.) Standing by for security presence.
Checking in on Darby Street and Elliott Street.

Darby Street and Elliott Street all clear. Spoke to Lumi Cafe and Recycling Boutique — all is okay with both businesses. Standing by for security presence, then heading up Wellesley Street towards Federal Street.
Heading up Wellesley Street towards the corner of Victoria Street and Federal Street.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria Street and Federal Street; commencing a sweep around the area.
Welfare check at Eighty Fed, 77 Convenience Store, Coffee Club, Amelia Cafe, Printshop and the news agency store, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to the office for a break.
Received a call from Queen Street McDonald's about a wandering dog; staff were worried the dog might bite someone. Heading there now.
The owner came for her dog — the same vagrant known to have the brown dog. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to the office for a break.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key. All photos and videos to be attached to the end-of-shift report.
Handover completed with the Morning Shift; standing by charging the Ops Phone (14:35–15:00).
Commenced patrols from HQ onto Queen Street, starting with the upper Queen Street areas.
Welfare check completed on Cotton On Queen Street, no issues.
Welfare check completed on Unichem Queen Street, no issues.
Welfare check completed on Queen Street McDonald's, no issues.
Welfare check completed on Ippondo Queen Street, no issues.
Welfare check completed on Recycle Boutique, no issues; Darby Street full sweep completed.
Elliott Street sweep completed, no issues.
Arrived at Elliott Stables; commencing welfare checks on the Stables and Jungle 8.

Elliott Stables sweep completed; check-in with Jungle 8, all clear. Staff had an altercation with an aggressive vagrant just before we arrived but could not accurately describe him; standing by maintaining presence.
Full sweep of Elliott Street with welfare checks at Elliott Stables, the Atrium Food Court and the George Harrison store, all clear; patrolling down Wellesley Street.
Welfare check along Wellesley Street, all clear; patrolling down Queen Street.
Welfare check, all clear, no issues; commencing welfare checks down Queen Street:
Commencing a sweep on Durham Street.
Full sweep of Durham Street with welfare checks at the corner of Durham, both Wilson carparks, Durham Supermart, BBQ Palace and Hazy Tiger, all clear, no issues; continuing down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street with welfare checks on stores from Mecca and Farmers down to ANZ and Van Cleef Arpels, all clear; arrived at Britomart and commencing a sweep.
Full sweep of Britomart with welfare checks on all stores in the vicinity, all clear.
Full sweep of Customs Street West; patrolling down the top of Fort Street.
Welfare check at Gore Street, Harbour Suites, Smiley Mart, Liquor K and Giapo, all clear; continuing route patrols.
Full sweep of Fort Street with welfare checks on Sal's Pizza, Tribe Hotel, the Italian restaurant and the Fort Wilson Carpark, all clear, no issues; patrolling Fort Lane.
Full sweep of Fort Lane, all clear; patrolling up High Street:
Bottom of High Street; welfare checks on stores from Barkers and Corner Bar through to Pieces and Vapo, all clear. Arrived at Freyberg Place and commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place and Chancery Square with welfare checks at O'Connell Street, Chancery Street and all open stores in the area; continuing routes.
Standing down patrols — response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male vagrant inside the premises disturbing customers and threatening staff members.

Arrived at the location; the male vagrant was still in the premises. Kindly approached him and asked him to move along elsewhere; he told us he was waiting for the Police to arrive. Standing by until Police arrive.
Police have arrived at the location; standing by in case Police assistance is needed.
Currently maintaining presence at McDonald's Queen Street.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street; Police assistance stood down — the male vagrant has been taken in. All clear; heading back to Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging the Ops Phone (18:50–19:15).
Full sweep of Darby Street, all clear; patrolling Elliott Street.
Full sweep of Elliott Street with welfare checks at the Elliott Wilson Carpark, Dominos and The Fresh Market, all clear; arrived at Elliott Stables, standing by.
Welfare check at Elliott Stables, all clear, no issues; patrolling to Aotea Square through the Metro Centre.
Metro Centre all clear, no issues; arrived at Aotea Square and commencing a sweep of the area.
Currently still at Aotea Square maintaining presence (through 20:50).
Full sweep of Aotea Square, all clear, no issues; patrolling down Queen Street.
Full sweep of the top half of Queen Street with welfare checks on all remaining open businesses in the area, all clear; standing by at McDonald's Queen Street.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, all clear, no issues; heading back to Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing the 30-minute break.
Break completed; standing by outside Headquarters until guard handover.
Afternoon shift concluded; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. All photos and videos to be attached to the end-of-shift report.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; conducting checks in the area.
Received a call from a fellow ASG guard regarding an alarm going off around the Civic / Aotea Square area; the guard was unsure if it was an emergency and contacted HOTC. Heading to the Civic.
Arrived at the Civic; emergency response services were on-site tending to the situation. Standing by, ready to assist if needed.
Emergency response services have left the scene — a fire alarm had been pulled and it turned out to be a false alarm. Carrying on with usual patrols.
Welfare check at Queen Street McDonald's; the only complaint from staff concerned a drunk male inside previously. The issue was noted for future reference.

Encountered the intoxicated male from the earlier Queen Street McDonald's staff complaint; he asked for directions to the nearest pub. No issues with the male; he was advised not to return to the restaurant for the rest of the night to avoid possible conflict. Continuing patrols.
Sweep through Darby and Elliott Street.
Darby / Elliott Street all clear; Atrium secured. Heading towards Victoria Street West.
Albert Street all clear; welfare check at Skymart.
77 Convenience Store all clear; conducting a sweep down Federal Street.
Federal Street all clear; heading back down Queen Street.
Conducting a sweep at Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay all clear; welfare check at Britomart McDonald's. Standing by to show presence and await response calls.
All clear, no issues or signs of disturbance in the area; continuing patrols.
Conducting a sweep throughout Freyberg Square.
Freyberg Square all clear; only sleeping vagrants in sight, no cause for concern. Moving along up High Street.
Intersection at Lorne Street on Victoria Street East all clear; little to no foot traffic in the area. Heading to Headquarters to conduct floor checks.
Floor checks completed; standing by to charge the Ops Phone, currently on 4%. Awaiting response calls in the meantime.
Phone charged sufficiently to continue patrols; no response calls were received in the meantime. Heading up Queen Street.
Welfare check at Queen Street McDonald's; staff relayed no further complaints at this point. Heading up Wellesley Street East towards the Central City Library.
Besides vagrants sleeping outside the library, the area is relatively quiet; no cause for concern at this time. Heading towards Aotea Square.
Conducting a sweep in Aotea Square.
Aotea Square all clear; nothing alarming at this hour and the area is secure. Little to no foot traffic during the sweep and standby; no response calls received. Moving along.
Checking in on the Civic; the alarms raised earlier in the shift have since been deactivated by emergency response services. Area is secured.
Conducting a sweep down Elliott and Darby Street.
Elliott and Darby Street all clear; Atrium secured. Carpark all clear, no sign of any break-ins.
Welfare check at Skymart on Victoria Street West; no complaints.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store; no issues for staff. A few vagrants loitering outside; the merchant has no complaints.
Back on Queen Street; patrols are quiet since resuming.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; conducting a sweep.
Commercial Bay all clear; welfare check at Britomart McDonald's, staff had no complaints. Stood by awaiting response calls; none received. Area free of disturbances at this hour; moving along.
Shortland Street all clear, no civilians in sight. Continuing up High Street.
Conducting a sweep throughout Freyberg Square.
Freyberg Square all clear; everything still secured from the last sweep.
Arrived at the Victoria Street East intersection; heading to Headquarters for our break and handover with the morning team upon arrival.

flags: SENSITIVE: 18:05 McDonald's Queen Street — male vagrant disturbing customers and threatening staff; Police attended and took him into custody ('taken in' counted as an arrest).
NOTE: Morning log opens at 06:45 with a short patrol segment, then records 'morning shift deployed' again at 09:00; 07:42–09:00 spent at HQ charging the Ops Phone.
NOTE: Morning equipment list contained no radios.
NOTE: 10:01 Metropolis Hotel and 23:14 Civic alarms were fire-alarm / emergency-services events (both resolved, Civic a false alarm) — counted as calls, not police events.
